idea: every self-training arm so far changed which teacher pseudo-labels were kept and used the teacher's own coordinates as supervision, so the student inherits the teacher's structured keypoint error. Here the coordinates themselves are refined using image evidence from neighbouring real RGB frames, then constrained by the known pallet cuboid.
question: does multi-frame RGB evidence actually move the teacher's keypoint coordinates closer to ground truth

paper_contract_preserved.claim_candidate: synthetic-to-real self-training using monocular RGB target video

depth_is_not_read.reason: the depth track is stopped as a main-method candidate and kept only as diagnostic evidence; reading it here would break the monocular claim

optical_flow.why_classical: an external pretrained flow network would add a new confound and break the pure-RGB geometric character of the pilot; a failure here must stay simple to explain

tracklet.ordering: by nanosecond filename timestamp, the real acquisition order

center_frame_requirements: genuine manual or reviewed 2D cuboid keypoints
resolvable to a raw RGB recording by image SHA256
neighbouring RGB frames exist in that recording

excluded.pallet11_gt: recorded as apriltag-broken well before this work
excluded.FT_OVERLAP_or_evaluation_ineligible: never used as a pilot centre
excluded.why_whole_recordings: so a prospective confirmation population for this method is not spent in advance

population.scope_limitation_declared_now: strict recording exclusion leaves no daytime centre at all. The pilot therefore measures a night-only, plastic-only slice, and any result must be read that way. This is stated before the measurement, not after.
population.population_limited_flag_rule: if usable centres had been too few to measure, report POPULATION_LIMITED and stop rather than relaxing the exclusion. 88 centres across 7 recordings is measurable, so the pilot proceeds with the composition limitation recorded instead.

keypoint_validity.applies_to: both the neighbour source keypoint and the centre keypoint

algorithm.step_1_transport: for each tracklet frame and keypoint, walk the teacher coordinate to the centre frame through consecutive RGB pairs, computing forward and backward flow at every hop
algorithm.any_hop_failure: that neighbour observation is rejected for that keypoint
algorithm.step_2_observation_set: centre teacher plus every surviving transported neighbour
algorithm.below_minimum: mark TEMPORAL_UNRESOLVED; never fall back to the raw teacher and count it as a success
algorithm.step_3_consensus: coordinate-wise median, x and y independently
algorithm.step_4_geometry: solve the frozen PnP contract on the consensus coordinates for both physical width/depth hypotheses and keep the one with the smaller median reprojection residual, computed without any ground truth; then reproject the cuboid corners and centroid

three_versions_saved_per_frame.TEMPORAL_GEOMETRY: consensus, then cuboid PnP, then reprojection
three_versions_saved_per_frame.why_three: to separate whether temporal RGB evidence helps at all from whether the geometry projection adds anything

generator_evaluator_separation.enforcement: the refinement function takes no ground-truth argument, and a test asserts that by AST inspection

2D.gross20: fraction of supervised corners with error above 20 px, lower better

definitions_are_reused_not_redefined.2D: Euclidean keypoint error in original image coordinates

no_hyperparameter_rescue.rule: this locked pilot is evaluated exactly once
forbidden_after_seeing_results: swapping in a learned flow network
replacing the median with a weighted mean
no_hyperparameter_rescue.if_it_does_not_improve: TEMPORAL_METHOD_PILOT = FAILED_TO_IMPROVE, and no further method search is opened

verdict_axes.categories_are_closed: no verdict string outside these lists may be written; an assertion in the evaluation code enforces it

visual_diagnostic.selection: deterministic by frame ordering, never by good or bad outcome
